```python
def solve(case):
    nodes = case["nodes"]
    required_symbols = set(case["required_symbols"])
    
    # Build a map of node_id -> node
    node_map = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes}
    
    # Build children map
    children = {n["id"]: [] for n in nodes}
    for n in nodes:
        if n["parent"] is not None:
            children[n["parent"]].append(n["id"])
    
    # Determine processing order: deeper first, then by node ID ascending
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"]))
    
    # Track retained status
    retained = {n["id"]: True for n in nodes}
    removed_order = []
    
    for node in sorted_nodes:
        nid = node["id"]
        
        # Can't remove if not removable
        if not node["removable"]:
            continue
        
        # Can't remove if symbol is required
        if node["symbol"] in required_symbols:
            continue
        
        # Can't remove if has retained children
        has_retained_children = any(retained[cid] for cid in children[nid])
        if has_retained_children:
            continue
        
        # Check if all required symbols remain represented after removal
        # Current symbols in retained nodes (excluding this node)
        remaining_symbols = set()
        for n in nodes:
            if n["id"] != nid and retained[n["id"]]:
                remaining_symbols.add(n["symbol"])
        
        if required_symbols.issubset(remaining_symbols):
            retained[nid] = False
            removed_order.append(nid)
    
    retained_ids = sorted(nid for nid, r in retained.items() if r)
    
    return {
        "removed_node_ids": removed_order,
        "retained_node_ids": retained_ids
    }
```
